title: Hash-chained traces: a runner-written ChainedJournal verifies with stored digests equal to an independent recomputation, the seal equals the head and re-verification is stable, editing any stored byte of a line (payload or ts) breaks the chain at that line, deletion and reorder break at the first mislinked line, the head changes under tampering so a recorded seal exposes the edit, torn tails isolate with an intact but unsealable prefix, plain journals verify honestly as chained:false and refuse to seal, the empty journal reports the zero state, and appending to a chained journal continues the chain
